guiActions.name: recallToBoard
guiActions.description: Retrieve a bounded, diverse packet from File Brain and Hindsight and stage source cards for visible human review

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Specific retrieval query grounded in the current whiteboard task

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional total source-card limit; clamped to 1-6

guiActions.name: stageOpening
guiActions.description: Stage a proposed opening brief and source cards from what changed, tensions, open questions, and 2-3 possible starts

parameters.name: brief
parameters.description: Object with summary, whatChanged[], tensions[], openQuestions[], and starts[]

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Optional source cards keyed by id; each has title, excerpt/body, sourceUri/sourceId, and kind

guiActions.name: proposeTransaction
guiActions.description: Stage safe semantic CWM upserts as an AI proposal; commitment, deletion, confirmation, and raw scene operations are forbidden

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: Object containing rationale and semantic operations[]

guiActions.name: showFocus
guiActions.description: Ephemerally highlight semantic object and region ids without changing canvas content

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Object with objectIds[], regionIds[], and optional reason

guiActions.name: focusRegion
guiActions.description: Move the viewport to an existing semantic region by id

voice.description: Navigate to a known whiteboard region by id without changing board content

guiActions.name: openBoard
guiActions.description: Open an eligible relative .excalidraw board path through jWhiteboard's loader

voice.description: Open an eligible whiteboard path without editing its content
